says: Today's lead tooling: stepcommit.sh refuses a lead commit of a lane's own field rows when the lane's approved plan has no files-table row for field/, though the lead skill says a lane's field rows are committed with stepcommit as lead (--commit-only included, which runs the same owner check), so the rows cannot land in the lane's pull request without a plan amendment and a new approval.
proof: In the ticket 936 worktree, at 8f313331038b99761360df5e4d56d868bc28c551, `sh .agents/skills/step-commit/scripts/stepcommit.sh lead 936 "T936 lead: field rows ..." field/findings/2026-11-13-child-start-scans-the-child-inbox.json ...` printed `stepcommit: not_owner: field/findings/2026-11-13-child-start-scans-the-child-inbox.json`; `plancheck.sh --owners-json` on the approved plan lists only next/ and docs/plan/tier-1.md paths, and owner_of (stepcommit.sh:87) gives a field/ path no owner.
cost: Every boxed lane whose plan omits field/ needs a lead plan amendment, or a rows-only pull request under a ticket of its own, before its run and finding rows can land, and a lead helper cannot finish the rows step at all.
head: 8f313331038b99761360df5e4d56d868bc28c551
